source: live enumeration of https://gis.blm.gov/<instance>/rest/services?f=json and every folder listing beneath it, 2026-09-05
note: Inventory of every ArcGIS Server REST service the Bureau of Land Management publishes anonymously on its own gis.blm.gov host. BLM runs one national instance plus twelve state instances. Every instance reports ArcGIS Server 11.5 with isTokenBasedSecurity=false, i.e. the service directory and its layer/query operations are anonymously callable. This file is a probed inventory, not a contract: the machine-readable contracts are the per-service ?f=json resource documents and, for the 42 WMS-enabled national services, the OGC GetCapabilities documents saved verbatim alongside it in openapi/.
server_product: Esri ArcGIS Server 11.5 (operated by BLM on blm.gov infrastructure)
